info.name: Pharmacy Management API
info.description: Source-audited collection for every route registered by app.js. Protected requests inherit optional Bearer authentication and also work with the accessToken/refreshToken cookies stored automatically by Postman's cookie jar after login. Mutation, destructive, external-service, authorization, and known-defect requests are guarded by environment flags; see postman/README.md.

item.name: Contract Checks

request.description: Admin only. The validator declares page > 0, limit 1-100, role admin|pharmacist|cashier, a full valid email, name, and isActive. All are disabled by default because validateQuery stores parsed values in req.validatedQuery while this controller reads raw req.query: page/limit can reach Prisma as strings and isActive is never applied. role, email, and name still work as raw strings. Captures a non-admin userId when available.

request.description: Uses the refreshToken cookie from Postman's cookie jar, deletes the matching database token, and clears both auth cookies. The route has no authenticate middleware, but the controller requires the cookie. The body token is independently required by logoutSchema (10-100 chars) and is otherwise ignored. Kept last so collection runs retain authentication until teardown.
